column1: # PRN/PRNW decimal output, NUMOUT literal output and FCONV decimal-to-binary64.
# DIG and TK_FNUM are bound from the shared generator.
# PRN/PRNW share one rule section: W[n] >= 0, decimal, minimum field width 0 or 6.
# NUMOUT copies the original decimal span when nx != 1; otherwise prints nv as signed64,
# including INT64_MIN through unsigned magnitude division.
# FCONV input is nv=M < 10^18 and fk=k, representing M / 10^k.
# Normalize M and D=10^k to D <= M < 2D, then divide for 53 quotient bits.
# Round the remainder to nearest, ties to even; carry may adjust the exponent.
# Result is binary64 bits in nv, nx=1 for signed NUMOUT, and token TK_FNUM.
